title: Raulenciu
description: adds the romanian internet celebrity to the game
body:
![him](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e59e5049df2324216c4204f04d7690dedc4aef72_0.webp)

**Raulenciu** is a datapack that adds a the niche internet celebrity raulenciu  to your world — a silent, Zombified Piglin with a unique model and custom sounds. He doesn't attack. He just watches.

---

## 🎃 Features

- 👁️ **Automatic spawning** — appears near players every ~50 seconds, one at a time
- 🧍 **Staring behaviour** — manually rotates to face the nearest player within 4–24 blocks
- 🎁 **Random item drops** — occasionally drops gold nuggets or custom loot while alive
- 💀 **Custom sounds** — unique idle, hurt, death, and gift sounds via resource pack
- 🌫️ **Dramatic despawn** — smoke particles, teleport sound, and a final death cry
- ⏳ **Lifespan system** — despawns on his own after a while, or if you walk too far away

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| Minecraft Java | **1.21+** |
| OptiFine **or** EMF + ETF | Required for the custom model |
| Enciu Resource Pack | Bundled in the download — required for sounds & textures |

> ⚠️ Without the resource pack, Raulenciu will look like a normal Zombified Piglin and play no custom sounds.

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the zip and extract both the **datapack** and **resource pack**
2. Place the datapack into your world folder:
   ```
   .minecraft/saves/<your_world>/datapacks/
   ```
3. Place the resource pack into:
   ```
   .minecraft/resourcepacks/
   ```
4. Launch your world and run `/reload`
5. Enable **Enciu Resource Pack** via Options → Resource Packs

---

## 🎮 Behaviour

### Spawning
Raulenciu attempts to spawn every **1000 ticks (~50 seconds)**. Only one can exist at a time, and he will only target Survival mode players.

### What he does
- Silently rotates to stare at the nearest player
- Plays idle sounds at random intervals
- Cries out when hurt
- Despawns if all players move **100+ blocks away**

### Loot Drops
While alive, every ~500 ticks there's a chance he drops something:

| Drop | Chance |
|---|---|
| Custom loot table item | ~26% |
| Gold nugget | ~35% |
| Creepy sound, no item | ~39% |

There's also a small bonus drop chance on despawn.
![item example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8717eb08c6421ec6f10ef16cc61834296b95cccd.png)
---

## 🔊 Sounds

All sounds are in the `raulenciu` namespace, bundled in the resource pack:

| Event | Sound ID |
|---|---|
| Idle (×3 variants) | `raulenciu:entity.raulenciu.idle` |
| Hurt (×3 variants) | `raulenciu:entity.raulenciu.hurt` |
| Death | `raulenciu:entity.raulenciu.death` |
| Gift drop | `raulenciu:entity.raulenciu.gift` |

---

## 🛠️ Debug Commands

```
/function raulenciu:debug_spawn       — force spawn Raulenciu instantly
/function raulenciu:debug_drop_loot   — force a loot drop
/function raulenciu:give_all_items    — give yourself all custom items
```

---

## ⚠️ Known Limitations

- Custom 3D model requires **OptiFine** or **EMF + ETF** — vanilla clients see a default Zombified Piglin
